overall_notes: This paper is primarily about DETECTING LLM-generated Korean text (detection task), not about evaluating the quality of generated text. The human evaluation is conducted to compare human-written vs LLM-generated text characteristics, not to evaluate the quality of generated outputs. Automatic metrics like AUC-ROC are used for detection performance evaluation, not for NLG quality assessment. The extraction incorrectly interpreted the detection methods as evaluation methods.
